# Phase 4: Manifest Migration Implementation Plan

> **For Claude:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.

**Goal:** Replace hand-maintained CSV manifests (`src/bmad/_config/bmad-help.csv` and `agent-manifest.csv`) with manifests auto-generated at build time from the skill directory tree, so adding or updating a skill automatically updates all manifests.

**Architecture:** During build, walk the merged `dist/_bmad/` tree to discover all skills. Generate three outputs: (1) `agent-manifest.csv` from `bmad-skill-manifest.yaml` files, (2) `skill-manifest.csv` from all SKILL.md files, (3) `bmad-help.csv` by concatenating per-module `module-help.csv` files. All outputs land in `dist/_bmad/_config/`. The hand-maintained source files in `src/bmad/_config/` are then deleted.

**Tech Stack:** Node.js (ESM), YAML parsing (regex-based, no new deps), CSV generation

## Task 1: Add YAML parsing utility

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/build.js`

**Context:** We need to parse `bmad-skill-manifest.yaml` files to extract agent metadata. Node.js doesn't have built-in YAML parsing. Options:
1. Use the `js-yaml` package (already available if installed)
2. Write a minimal YAML parser for the simple flat key-value format used by these files
3. Use regex extraction for the specific fields we need

The manifest YAML files are simple flat key-value (no nesting, no arrays), so option 3 is most practical — no new dependency needed.

**Step 1: Add a parseSimpleYaml helper to build.js**

Add this function after the `exists()` function:

```javascript
function parseSimpleYaml(content) {
  const result = {};
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const colonIdx = trimmed.indexOf(':');
    if (colonIdx < 1) continue;
    const key = trimmed.slice(0, colonIdx).trim();
    let value = trimmed.slice(colonIdx + 1).trim();
    // Strip surrounding quotes
    if (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) {
      value = value.slice(1, -1);
    }
    // Decode YAML unicode escapes (\U0001FXXX → actual emoji)
    value = value.replace(/\\U([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})/g, (_, hex) =>
      String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(hex, 16)),
    );
    result[key] = value;
  }
  return result;
}
```

This handles: quoted values with special chars, values with colons (splits on first `:` only), `\U` YAML unicode escapes (4 manifest files use this for emoji), and comments.

**Step 2: Add a listFilesRecursive helper to build.js**

This was removed in Phase 3. We need it back for walking dist:

```javascript
async function listFilesRecursive(rootPath, currentPath = rootPath, files = []) {
  const entries = await fs.readdir(currentPath, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const entryPath = path.join(currentPath, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      await listFilesRecursive(rootPath, entryPath, files);
    } else {
      files.push(path.relative(rootPath, entryPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    }
  }
  return files;
}
```

**Step 3: Verify build still passes**

Run: `node tools/build.js`

**Step 4: Commit**

```bash
git add tools/build.js
git commit -m "feat(build): add YAML parsing and file listing helpers for manifest generation"
```

## Task 2: Implement agent-manifest.csv generation

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/build.js`

**Context:** Walk `dist/_bmad/` to find all `bmad-skill-manifest.yaml` files where `type: agent`. Extract metadata and write `dist/_bmad/_config/agent-manifest.csv`.

**Step 1: Add generateAgentManifest() function**

```javascript
async function generateAgentManifest() {
  const configDir = path.join(BMAD_DIST, '_config');
  await fs.mkdir(configDir, { recursive: true });

  const allFiles = await listFilesRecursive(BMAD_DIST);
  const manifestFiles = allFiles.filter((f) => f.endsWith('/bmad-skill-manifest.yaml'));

  const agents = [];
  for (const relPath of manifestFiles) {
    const fullPath = path.join(BMAD_DIST, relPath);
    const content = await fs.readFile(fullPath, 'utf-8');
    const data = parseSimpleYaml(content);
    if (data.type !== 'agent') continue;

    const skillDir = path.dirname(relPath);
    agents.push({
      id: `_bmad/${skillDir}/SKILL.md`,
      name: data.name || '',
      displayName: data.displayName || '',
      title: data.title || '',
      icon: data.icon || '',
      role: data.role || '',
      identity: data.identity || '',
      communicationStyle: data.communicationStyle || '',
      principles: data.principles || '',
      module: data.module || '',
      path: `_bmad/${relPath}`,
    });
  }

  // Sort by module then name for stable output
  agents.sort((a, b) => a.module.localeCompare(b.module) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  const header = '"id","name","displayName","title","icon","role","identity","communicationStyle","principles","module","path"';
  const rows = agents.map((a) => {
    const escape = (v) => `"${(v || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    return [a.id, a.name, a.displayName, a.title, a.icon, a.role, a.identity, a.communicationStyle, a.principles, a.module, a.path].map(escape).join(',');
  });

  const csv = [header, ...rows].join('\n') + '\n';
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(configDir, 'agent-manifest.csv'), csv);
  console.log(`  Generated agent-manifest.csv (${agents.length} agents)`);
}
```

**Step 2: Call from buildBmadSkills()**

In `buildBmadSkills()`, keep the existing `_config/` copy block for now (it provides `bmad-help.csv` until Task 3 generates it). Add the agent manifest call AFTER the copy, so it overwrites the old `agent-manifest.csv`:

```javascript
  // Temporary: copy old _config/ (bmad-help.csv still needed from source until Task 3)
  const oldConfig = path.join(SRC, 'bmad', '_config');
  if (await exists(oldConfig)) {
    const configDest = path.join(BMAD_DIST, '_config');
    await copyDir(oldConfig, configDest);
  }

  // Generate agent-manifest.csv (overwrites old hand-maintained version)
  await generateAgentManifest();
```

**Step 3: Verify build**

Run: `node tools/build.js`

Then verify the generated manifest:

```bash
head -3 dist/_bmad/_config/agent-manifest.csv
wc -l dist/_bmad/_config/agent-manifest.csv
```

Expected: Header + one row per agent found in dist. The `id` column should use new `_bmad/{module}/{phase}/{skill}/SKILL.md` paths (not old `_bmad/modules/custom/` paths).

## Task 3: Implement bmad-help.csv generation (module-help merge)

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/build.js`

**Context:** Concatenate all per-module `module-help.csv` files from `dist/_bmad/` into a unified `dist/_bmad/_config/bmad-help.csv`. The per-module files use a 13-column format. The unified output should use the same 13-column format.

**Step 1: Add generateBmadHelp() function**

```javascript
async function generateBmadHelp() {
  const configDir = path.join(BMAD_DIST, '_config');
  await fs.mkdir(configDir, { recursive: true });

  const header = 'module,skill,display-name,menu-code,description,action,args,phase,after,before,required,output-location,outputs';
  const allRows = [];

  // Dynamically discover modules (all top-level dirs in dist/_bmad/ except _config)
  const bmadEntries = await fs.readdir(BMAD_DIST, { withFileTypes: true });
  const moduleNames = bmadEntries
    .filter((e) => e.isDirectory() && !e.name.startsWith('_'))
    .map((e) => e.name);

  for (const modName of moduleNames) {
    const csvPath = path.join(BMAD_DIST, modName, 'module-help.csv');
    if (!(await exists(csvPath))) continue;

    const content = await fs.readFile(csvPath, 'utf-8');
    const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);

    // Skip header row (first line), add data rows
    for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
      if (lines[i].trim()) {
        allRows.push(lines[i]);
      }
    }
  }

  const csv = [header, ...allRows].join('\n') + '\n';
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(configDir, 'bmad-help.csv'), csv);
  console.log(`  Generated bmad-help.csv (${allRows.length} skills from ${moduleNames.length} modules)`);
}
```

**Step 2: Call from buildBmadSkills()**

Add the call after `generateAgentManifest()`:

```javascript
  await generateAgentManifest();
  await generateBmadHelp();
```

**Step 3: Verify build**

Run: `node tools/build.js`

Then verify:

```bash
head -5 dist/_bmad/_config/bmad-help.csv
wc -l dist/_bmad/_config/bmad-help.csv
```

Expected: 13-column header + rows from all 4 modules. Should have ~44 rows (29 bmm + 10 core + 2 compass + 3 bmad-builder).

**Step 4: Commit**

```bash

git commit -m "feat(build): auto-generate bmad-help.csv by merging per-module module-help.csv files"
```

## Task 5: Add manifest validation to validate.js

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/validate.js`

**Context:** Now that manifests are generated, add validation to ensure:
1. Every agent skill has a `bmad-skill-manifest.yaml`
2. Generated `agent-manifest.csv` exists in dist after build
3. Generated `bmad-help.csv` exists in dist after build

**Step 1: Add validateGeneratedManifests() function**

```javascript
async function validateGeneratedManifests() {
  let ok = true;

  // Check agent skills have manifest YAML
  const moduleRoots = [
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'native', 'bmm-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'native', 'core-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'bmm-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'core-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'compass-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'bmad-builder-skills'),
  ];

  for (const moduleRoot of moduleRoots) {
    if (!(await exists(path.relative(ROOT, moduleRoot)))) continue;
    const files = await listFilesRecursive(moduleRoot);

    for (const filePath of files) {
      const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      if (!normalized.endsWith('/SKILL.md')) continue;

      const dirName = path.basename(path.dirname(filePath));
      // Agent skills start with "bmad-agent-" or "bmad-master"
      if (!dirName.startsWith('bmad-agent-') && dirName !== 'bmad-master') continue;

      const manifestPath = path.join(path.dirname(filePath), 'bmad-skill-manifest.yaml');
      try {
        await fs.access(manifestPath);
      } catch {
        console.error(`ERROR agent skill ${dirName} missing bmad-skill-manifest.yaml`);
        ok = false;
      }
    }
  }

  if (ok) console.log('OK agent manifest validation');
  return ok;
}
```

**Step 2: Add to validate() Promise.all**

```javascript
const checks = await Promise.all([

  validateCodexConfig(),
  validateSourceSecretScan(),
  validateSkillFormat(),

```

## Task 6: Generate skill-manifest.csv

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/build.js`

**Context:** The design doc requires a `skill-manifest.csv` listing ALL skills (agents + workflows) from all modules. Generate it by walking SKILL.md files in `dist/_bmad/`.

**Step 1: Add generateSkillManifest() function**

```javascript
async function generateSkillManifest() {
  const configDir = path.join(BMAD_DIST, '_config');
  await fs.mkdir(configDir, { recursive: true });

  const allFiles = await listFilesRecursive(BMAD_DIST);
  const skillFiles = allFiles.filter((f) => f.endsWith('/SKILL.md'));

  const skills = [];
  for (const relPath of skillFiles) {
    const fullPath = path.join(BMAD_DIST, relPath);
    const content = await fs.readFile(fullPath, 'utf-8');
    const frontmatter = content.match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---/);
    if (!frontmatter) continue;

    const nameMatch = frontmatter[1].match(/^name:\s*(.+)$/m);
    const descMatch = frontmatter[1].match(/^description:\s*['"]?(.*?)['"]?\s*$/m);
    if (!nameMatch) continue;

    const name = nameMatch[1].trim().replace(/['"]/g, '');
    const description = descMatch ? descMatch[1].trim() : '';
    const skillDir = path.dirname(relPath);
    const module = relPath.split('/')[0]; // First path segment is the module
    const isAgent = name.startsWith('bmad-agent-') || name === 'bmad-master';

    skills.push({
      name,
      type: isAgent ? 'agent' : 'workflow',
      description,
      module,
      path: `_bmad/${skillDir}`,
    });
  }

  skills.sort((a, b) => a.module.localeCompare(b.module) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  const header = 'name,type,description,module,path';
  const rows = skills.map((s) => {
    const escape = (v) => `"${(v || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    return [s.name, s.type, s.description, s.module, s.path].map(escape).join(',');
  });

  const csv = [header, ...rows].join('\n') + '\n';
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(configDir, 'skill-manifest.csv'), csv);
  console.log(`  Generated skill-manifest.csv (${skills.length} skills)`);
}
```

**Step 2: Call from buildBmadSkills()**

Add after `generateBmadHelp()`:

```javascript
  await generateSkillManifest();
```

**Step 3: Verify build**

Run: `node tools/build.js`

```bash
head -5 dist/_bmad/_config/skill-manifest.csv
wc -l dist/_bmad/_config/skill-manifest.csv
```

**Step 4: Commit**

```bash
git add tools/build.js
git commit -m "feat(build): auto-generate skill-manifest.csv from SKILL.md files"
```

## Task 8: Add after/before dependency validation

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/validate.js`

**Context:** The design doc requires validating that `after`/`before` dependency references in `module-help.csv` resolve to real skill names. The 13-column format has `after` (col 8) and `before` (col 9) columns.

**Step 1: Add parseCsvLine helper back to validate.js**

We need CSV parsing again for this validation:

```javascript
function parseCsvLine(line) {
  const cells = [];
  let current = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    const char = line[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      if (inQuotes && line[i + 1] === '"') { current += '"'; i++; }
      else { inQuotes = !inQuotes; }
      continue;
    }
    if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) { cells.push(current); current = ''; continue; }
    current += char;
  }
  cells.push(current);
  return cells;
}
```

**Step 2: Add validateModuleHelpDeps() function**

```javascript
async function validateModuleHelpDeps() {
  let ok = true;

  // Collect all known skill names from SKILL.md files
  const knownSkills = new Set();
  const moduleRoots = [
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'native', 'bmm-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'native', 'core-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'bmm-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'core-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'compass-skills'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'bmad', 'modules', 'custom', 'bmad-builder-skills'),
  ];

  for (const moduleRoot of moduleRoots) {
    if (!(await exists(path.relative(ROOT, moduleRoot)))) continue;
    const files = await listFilesRecursive(moduleRoot);
    for (const filePath of files) {
      if (!filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').endsWith('/SKILL.md')) continue;
      knownSkills.add(path.basename(path.dirname(filePath)));
    }
  }

  // Check after/before refs in each module-help.csv
  const moduleHelpFiles = [
    'src/bmad/modules/native/bmm-skills/module-help.csv',
    'src/bmad/modules/native/core-skills/module-help.csv',
    'src/bmad/modules/custom/compass-skills/module-help.csv',
    'src/bmad/modules/custom/bmad-builder-skills/module-help.csv',
  ];

  for (const relPath of moduleHelpFiles) {
    if (!(await exists(relPath))) continue;
    const content = await fs.readFile(path.join(ROOT, relPath), 'utf-8');
    const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
    const header = parseCsvLine(lines[0]);
    const afterIdx = header.indexOf('after');
    const beforeIdx = header.indexOf('before');
    if (afterIdx < 0 && beforeIdx < 0) continue;

    for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const cells = parseCsvLine(lines[i]);
      for (const [colName, colIdx] of [['after', afterIdx], ['before', beforeIdx]]) {
        if (colIdx < 0 || !cells[colIdx]?.trim()) continue;
        const refs = cells[colIdx].split(/[,;]/).map((r) => r.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        for (const ref of refs) {
          if (!knownSkills.has(ref)) {
            console.error(`ERROR ${relPath}:${i + 1} ${colName} ref '${ref}' is not a known skill`);
            ok = false;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (ok) console.log('OK module-help dependency validation');
  return ok;
}
```

## Execution Notes

### Task Order

Tasks 1-3 are sequential (each builds on the previous). Task 4 depends on 2+3. Tasks 5-8 can be parallelized after Task 4. Task 9-10 depend on all prior tasks.

### Risk Mitigation

- **agent-manifest.csv format change:** The generated CSV uses new `_bmad/{module}/{phase}/{skill}/` paths instead of old `_bmad/modules/custom/bmm/agents/` paths. The `bmad-party-mode` and `bmad-retrospective` workflows read this CSV by column name — all expected columns are present in the generated output.
- **bmad-help.csv format change:** The generated CSV uses 13-column format instead of old 16-column format. The `bmad-help` skill and orchestrator agents are LLM-driven consumers that adapt to column name changes. The essential data (skill name, description, menu code) is present.
- **sync-client-bundles.js is BROKEN after this phase:** The script read the old 16-column format with columns (`command`, `sequence`, `workflow_file`, etc.) that don't exist in the new 13-column format. Rather than rework a 304-line script that Phase 5 will replace, we accept the breakage. The existing pre-generated command files in `src/claude/commands/bmad/` and `src/opencode/commands/bmad/` remain as-is and continue to work — users just can't regenerate them until Phase 5.
- **bmad-manifest.json:** One file exists (`bmad-product-brief/bmad-manifest.json`) — it's a workflow capability manifest (not an agent), so it is correctly excluded from agent-manifest generation. The skill-manifest.csv captures it via SKILL.md discovery.
- **\U escape handling:** The `parseSimpleYaml` function decodes `\U0001FXXX` YAML unicode escapes to actual emoji, matching the format consumers expect.
- **No new dependencies:** YAML parsing uses string splitting + regex, not a library.

### Known Limitation

- **Row count difference:** The generated `bmad-help.csv` has ~44 rows (from module-help.csv files) vs the old 74 rows. The old CSV had per-phase/per-mode granularity that the upstream 13-column format doesn't encode. The LLM-driven consumers (bmad-help skill, orchestrators) can work with either format. Phase 5's client bundle generation will use the skill directory tree directly, not this CSV.

### Build Must Pass After Each Task

After every commit, `node tools/build.js && node tools/validate.js` must pass.
